scope: Python service + MySQL, not HTTP throughput or model execution

hardware.resource_scope: Linux/WSL-visible host and benchmark Python process; not dedicated hardware or database-container CPU/RSS

sampling: Closed-loop bounded coroutine workers; latency includes service authorization, transaction, database, row materialization and connection acquisition; excludes seeding and warmup. Acquisition includes connect/pre_ping, not pure queue wait. Peak RSS is cumulative process high-water mark.

message_cursor.sql: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE workspace_id=:w AND conversation_id=:c AND seq>:s ORDER BY seq LIMIT 50

document_list.sql: SELECT d.*, p.title, v.file_id, v.parse_status, v.index_status FROM documents d JOIN project_papers pp ON pp.paper_id=d.paper_id JOIN papers p ON p.id=d.paper_id JOIN document_versions v ON v.id=COALESCE(d.active_version,(SELECT lv.id FROM document_versions lv WHERE lv.document_id=d.id AND lv.workspace_id=:w ORDER BY lv.created_at DESC,lv.id DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE d.workspace_id=:w AND pp.workspace_id=:w AND pp.project_id=:p AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at,d.id LIMIT 100

task_status.sql: SELECT * FROM research_tasks WHERE id=:t FOR UPDATE
